spec2def(ftfd.dll ftfd.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

list(APPEND SOURCE
    # enable.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ftfd-rust/src/ftfd/enable.rs)
    # font.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ftfd-rust/src/ftfd/font.rs)
    # glyph.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ftfd-rust/src/ftfd/glyph.rs)
    # rosglue.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ftfd-rust/src/ftfd/rosglue.rs)
    )

# ftfd.dll is all Rust (ftfd-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ftfd-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# sprintf.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ftfd-rust/src/ftfd/sprintf.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(ftfd_res OBJECT freetype.rc)
target_include_directories(ftfd_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_dependencies(ftfd_res psdk)
add_library(ftfd_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_link_libraries(ftfd_shims PRIVATE freetype libcntpr setjmp libwin32k)
add_dependencies(ftfd_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(ftfd ftfd-cargo ftfd.dll
    KIND kerneldll
    BODY_CRATE ftfd-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ftfd_shims ftfd_res asm psdk)
